item.title: Bitcoin Blockchain Splits as BIP-110 Enters Enforcement Phase
item.summary: The Bitcoin blockchain split into two competing chains on Aug. 8 after nodes running BIP-110 entered a mandatory-signaling phase that requires blocks to carry an approval signal. The development created a divergence between nodes enforcing the proposed rules and the broader network, where support among miners remains limited.
